attacks.name: Feilian Beringal - Echo Skill
attacks.sourceText:
Transform into Feilian Beringal to perform a powerful kick. If the kick lands on an enemy, immediately perform a follow-up strike. The kick deals 144.90% Aero DMG, and the follow-up strike deals 177.10% Aero DMG.
After the follow-up strike hits, the current character's Aero DMG increases by 12.00%, and the Heavy Attack DMG increases by 12.00% for 15s
